blocks.text:
After breakfast, the day is free so you can rest before the evening parade.

In the evening, the highlight of the tour begins: Carnival at the Sambadrome, with samba school parades, percussion sections, floats, costumes and a performance lasting for hours into the night.

The parade is a powerful physical experience: loud drums, the vibration of the stands, floodlights, mirrors and glittering costume details. The samba schools pass before the spectators one after another, each presenting a production they have prepared in advance. This is a full night at the Sambadrome.

Carnival tickets and transfers from the hotel to the Sambadrome and back are included in the programme.

After the parade, the group returns to the hotel. This evening is the emotional high point of the first part of the route: the daytime has almost no scheduled activities, while the night revolves around one event. Sightseeing resumes the next day, with the Carnival bustle behind you.
